title: NLTK regular expressions, graph traversal and XML corpora can exhaust workers
summary: Untrusted regex patterns incur expensive compilation before match timeouts. Deep dependency or custom WordNet graphs can exhaust recursion. Large XML comments and CDATA sections cause quadratic CPU work.

severity.rationale: The documented impact is worker denial of service from untrusted patterns or corpora. Specialized APIs must process the crafted input.

affected.note: Regex compile: >=3.10.0,<=3.10.3. XML: >=3.6,<=3.10.3. Dependency and WordNet traversal: <=3.10.3. All fixed in 3.10.4.

exposure: WordNet traversal requires a custom or foreign lexical resource, not the bundled default corpus. Other paths require untrusted tokenizer/search patterns, dependency parses or XML corpus input.

params.instructions: Check nltk version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to 3.10.4 or later before processing untrusted patterns and corpora.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
